prompt: Create a standalone, superwide 3:1 landscape illustration plate for a small Korean recording app. Refer to the supplied image ONLY for the risograph overprint character of the two anonymous ink portraits and their coloured cels. Deliver JUST the new painterly artwork, no website and no lettering. Imagine an airy conversation between two little ink-drawn people. At x=12% the head and shoulders of a speaker in violet, facing right; at x=88% a second speaker in pale persimmon, facing left. Both profiles are contained inside the middle third of the canvas height so that a wide cinematic crop cannot clip either face. The middle 60 percent of the width is nearly empty, a soft expanse of warm white-lilac paper with a whisper of light ink. The forms are subtle, clear, hand-pulled and elegant, not dense. Printed individual pencil strokes and very fine paper tooth. All edges and corners taper to exceptionally pale lavender #f4f0fa. Asymmetric, sensitive drawing from a contemporary Korean independent printmaker; colours should still be clear at small sizes. No rendered waveform, frequencies, pulses, lettering, numbers, logos, lines of text, UI, graphics frames, or buttons of any kind.
